Name: Sanyueqi
Author: yichengyanyugui
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Bring a new friendly face to Stardew Valley! San Yue Qi — A Traveler Through the Seasons adds a cheerful NPC who enjoys the little wonders of each season. Get to know her through daily conversations, share her favorite gifts, and find her exploring familiar places around the valley.
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download and extract the mod archive.[/*]
[*]Place the entire
[code][CP] SanYueQi[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Look for San Yue Qi at the Bus Stop in the morning![/*]
[/list]Make sure
[code]manifest.json[/code]is directly inside
[code]Mods/[CP] SanYueQi[/code], without an extra nested folder.
[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*]A new befriendable NPC with a cheerful personality.[/*]
[*]Four seasonal outfits with matching portraits and walking sprites.[/*]
[*]Chinese dialogue covering everyday conversations, seasons, friendship, birthdays, and special weather.[/*]
[*]Custom schedules with visits to the library, beach, saloon, and other familiar locations.[/*]
[*]Personal gift preferences—flowers and cakes are a great place to start![/*]
[*]A Spring 7 birthday, with social menu and calendar integration.[/*]
[/list]San Yue Qi is a friendship-only NPC. Romance, marriage, custom heart events, and festival appearances are not included in this version.
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or a compatible later 1.6 release.[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later.[/*]
[/list]In-game dialogue is currently available in Chinese.
[b]Shout outs[/b]
Thanks to ConcernedApe for creating Stardew Valley, the developers and contributors behind SMAPI and Content Patcher, and the Stardew Valley modding community for its helpful tools and documentation.
